name: Apply SSD config overrides
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@clementine.whatbox.ca "set -e; cd /mnt/nvme11n1/artemisprime/Upload-Assistant-wastaken; cfg=docker-data/data/config.py; backup=\"\${cfg}.bak.\$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)\"; cp -p \"\$cfg\" \"\$backup\"; sed -i -e 's/\"multiScreens\": \"\"/\"multiScreens\": \"0\"/' -e 's/\"charLimit\": \"\"/\"charLimit\": \"0\"/' -e 's/\"processLimit\": \"\"/\"processLimit\": \"0\"/' \"\$cfg\"; echo \"backup=\$backup\"; echo \"remaining_blank=\$(grep -c -E '\"(multiScreens|charLimit|processLimit)\": \"\"' \"\$cfg\" || true)\"; podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d --no-build upload-assistant-wastaken; sleep 12; podman ps --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}'; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:12346/api/health"
description: Back up Clementine’s persistent config, apply tracker overrides, restart the SSD client, and verify health.
